title: CP Trainer subject drills
description: drills/<subject>.json: algorithms of one subject with their time complexity. Lessons in that subject ask "What's the time complexity of …?".

subject.description: A visible subject id from taxonomy.json; the file is named after it.

id.description: Permanent within the file, e.g. dijkstra-heap.

name.description: English, like technique names. Specific enough to have one complexity ("Dijkstra with a binary heap", not "Dijkstra").

complexity.description: LaTeX, without $ delimiters, e.g. O((n + m) \log n). Use n, m, q… as the usual statement variables.

wrong.description: Exactly 3 plausible wrong complexities, all different from the right one.

explanation.description: Why it has that complexity, in one or two sentences.
